revisions.reason: Exact reviewed overlay baseline reconstructed from Git blob plus retained patch and SHA-256 verified in run 20261120-main-callback-lifetime-hex-context-finish. Actual committed cleanup regressions reproduced: throwing callbacks suppress siblings, reentrant stop lacks cached promise, startup metadata errors bypass cleanup, physical CPU exit prematurely certifies writer quiescence before renderer exit. Restore admission fencing, once-only fanout, cached reentrant promises, arbitrary error preservation, failed-owner explicit retry and both physical joins before quiescence. Production WorkerLink25/host15/startup29/bootstrap51/render-manager32 focused controls pass, together with actual Worker nested DLL unload, native DLL reader interleavings and Worker NE lifecycle/cancellation. Existing loader receipt/context/pin authority is unchanged; no new guest callback entry or nonlocal admission. Broader invocation ownership remains pending.
